desc: Start a compose using the selected blueprint and output type
r: composer-cli-compose-start - Start a compose using the selected blueprint and output type
Start a compose using the selected blueprint and output type. Optionally start an upload. --size is supported by osbuild-composer, and is in MiB

-h, --help
[=false] help for start
--size
=0 Size of image in MiB

-a, --api
=1 Server API Version to use
-j, --json
[=false] Output the raw JSON response instead of the normal output
--log
="" Path to optional logfile
-s, --socket
="/run/weldr/api.socket" Path to the server's socket file
--test
=0 Pass test mode to compose. 1=Mock compose with fail. 2=Mock compose with finished.
--timeout
=240 Timeout to use for server communication. Set to 0 for no timeout

composer-cli compose start tmux-image qcow2


  composer-cli compose start tmux-image qcow2 --size 4096


  composer-cli compose start tmux-image ami ami-name aws-upload.toml
